review.notes: The organization's site and ProPublica agree on East Bay Youth Development Foundation, Inc. DBA First Tee - Oakland, an Oakland 501(c)(3) (EIN 87-2495490, exempt since 2022) that pairs golf with life-skills programs for Oakland youth, which fits OUSD's no-cost after-school agreements from 2022-23 onward. The summary and address are supported and neutral; the sources do not name OUSD directly, but the exact name, city and program type match.
